a.lede: Just 9 months after raising an $180 million seed round, Flapping Airplanes has landed $1 billion Series A for its mission to build AI models "without ingesting half the internet."
a.title: Year-old AI lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1B at a $6B valuation

b.lede: Reliable Robotics extended its Series D round with $115 million in equity and $25 million in debt.
b.title: SpaceX alum’s aviation startup, Reliable Robotics, lands $115M, topping $1B valuation
